requirements.description: Reference population and Altman Z-score specification used to assign the BKRPTRANK deciles, including the mapping from lower Z scores to higher bankruptcy-risk ranks.

required_coverage.frequency: cross-sectional decile benchmark by applicable fiscal period
required_coverage.population: Unreported Altman Z score reference population for the baseline firms; the paper describes the 128 observations but does not state whether ranks are sample, industry, year, or broader-population deciles.
required_coverage.detail: The paper specifies that the lowest Z-score decile (highest risk) is assigned 10, but not the exact Altman Z formula/version, fiscal period, decile reference population or treatment of ties. These are separate from the sample-firm Compustat fields.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No verified source or definition identifies the Altman Z variant and ranking universe; sample-firm accounting data alone cannot determine the required decile cutoffs.

variable_coverage.construction: FULDISC is 1 for disclosure of all required auditor-change 8-K Item 4 items, 0 for test firms receiving an SEC comment letter; code initial 8-K Item 4 for controls and corrected 8-K/A Item 4 for test firms.
LNMV is ln Compustat market value of equity at fiscal-year end when the 8-K was issued; candidate current fields are mkvalt or csho×prcc_f, with exact product/scale mapping unverified.
BODINDPCT is the number of independent board members divided by total board members, manually coded from the relevant DEF14A proxy statement.
BODMEET is annual board meetings counted from the DEF14A proxy statement.
CEOCHAIR is 1 if the CEO is also board chair and 0 otherwise, coded from DEF14A.
AUDCOM is 1 if the board has an audit committee and 0 otherwise, coded from DEF14A.
ACMEET is the annual number of audit-committee meetings from DEF14A.
FINEXPRT counts financial experts; retain the frozen source conflict: Table 2 says audit committee or board, while the text says audit committee only.
CFOTENURE is years the CFO held the position, coded from DEF14A; appointment-date evidence and exact proxy timing need manual mapping.
CFOBOD is 1 if the CFO is a board member and 0 otherwise, coded from DEF14A.
INTCONMW is 1 for a reported material weakness under SOX 404, using SOX 302 reported information for smaller firms not subject to 404; Audit Analytics and filing text are candidate routes.
BIG4DEPART is 1 if the departing auditor immediately before the change was Big 4, coded from the auditor-change 8-K.

EXTFIN is subsequent-fiscal-year equity plus debt financing divided by total assets; candidate current Compustat fields include scstkc, spstkc, prstkc, dvc, dltis, dltr, dlcch and at, subject to semantic/unit mapping.

BKRPTRANK is the decile rank of Altman Z with the highest bankruptcy-risk decile (lowest Z) assigned 10 and descending risk assigned smaller values; exact Z version and ranking population remain unresolved.

design_coverage.reason: The baseline is a cross-sectional logistic regression; no fixed effects are specified in the equation or Table 5.
Table 5 reports Wald chi-square p-values but no standard-error correction or clustering dimension.
No weighting scheme is reported for the 128-firm Table 5 models.
Table 5 identifies logistic regression on the combined test/control sample; the paper does not report a conditional matched-pair estimator or the covariance procedure used for the Wald p-values.

implementation_issues.description: FINEXPRT is inconsistent in the source: Table 2 includes financial experts on the audit committee or board, while the explanatory text limits the count to the audit committee. This affects Model 1 directly and GOV in Model 2. Preserve both statements until a source-backed rule is available.

BKRPTRANK identifies the direction of Altman Z deciles but does not specify the score variant, fiscal-year period, reference population, tie handling or cutoffs. These definitions are required to reconstruct ranks and are not supplied by the sample-firm Compustat fields alone.

The paper says each test firm is matched to a control with the same bad news, but does not specify how to select one control if several firms qualify or provide the original 64 pairs. Rebuilding the exact 128-firm sample may therefore differ.

The source reports logistic regression and Wald chi-square p-values but does not describe the covariance correction or standard-error procedure. Exact reported inference cannot be determined from the article.

Manual review is needed to classify the 8-K Item 4 completeness and auditor-change bad-news items, distinguish minor comment-letter issues, and code the board, audit-committee and CFO measures from DEF14A filings.

Reconstructing the CIK/accession to Compustat GVKEY links and exact matched test/control identities requires date-valid issuer resolution; the local link table has suitable fields but no sample-specific link coverage confirmation.

EXTFIN and market-value measures require mapping current Compustat units and vintages to the article definitions. The local annual fields exist, but current labels do not by themselves verify the exact market-value product or financing-component coding.
GOV requires thresholds at the 128-firm sample medians, then adds the four directional binary conditions. The source states the median rule; missing-value handling is not reported.
Use current Compustat and Audit Analytics vintages for the original 2005–2007 design. The article’s historic data vintage and any later vendor revisions are not specified.

evidence.description: Defines the comment-letter posting window for the test-firm screen.

evidence.quote: We match those 64 test firms with 64 control firms that also reported auditor changes via Form 8-K but that did not receive SEC comment letters.
evidence.description: Defines the 64 test plus 64 control baseline sample.

evidence.quote: We match each test firm with a control firm that had the same bad news but that properly disclosed the bad news and therefore did not receive a comment letter from the SEC.
evidence.description: States the matching criterion; exact control-selection rule is not reported.

evidence.quote: For test firms, we determine the actual information state by reading corrected 8-K Item 4 s (8-K/A Item 4 s).
evidence.description: Defines the filing content used to code disclosure state for test firms.

evidence.quote: BODINDPCT =percent of members of firm’s board of directors who are described as independent in proxy statements.
evidence.description: Shows proxy statements are used for board governance measures.

evidence.quote: LNMV =natural log of market value of equity at end of fiscal year when 8-K was issued.
evidence.description: Defines market value and fiscal-year timing.

evidence.quote: PRIORGC equals one if the last audit report before the auditor change included a going concern audit opinion and zero otherwise.
evidence.description: Defines the prior going-concern control.

evidence.quote: FINEXPRT =number of financial experts on the audit committee or the board; 0 otherwise.
evidence.description: Table 2 definition of FINEXPRT.

evidence.quote: FINEXPRT equals the number of financial experts on the audit committee, as defined by the SEC and as designated by the firm.
evidence.description: Narrative FINEXPRT definition conflicts with the broader Table 2 definition.

evidence.quote: We add one to the value of GOV if the value of BODINDPCT, BODMEET, ACMEET, FINEXPRT, or CFOTENURE is larger than the sample median, respectively.
evidence.description: Defines five sample-median indicators in the GOV index.

evidence.quote: For smaller firms not subject to SOX Sect. 404, we use internal control information reported under SOX Sect. 302.
evidence.description: Shows that the internal-control indicator also needs 302 reports for some firms.

evidence.quote: It is measured in the fiscal year after the auditor change.
evidence.description: Defines the EXTFIN measurement year.

evidence.quote: It is computed following Bradshaw et al. (2006) as the sum of equity financing and debt financing in the subsequent fiscal year, scaled by total assets.
evidence.description: Defines EXTFIN source, timing, and scale.

evidence.quote: Those in the lowest decile of Z scores (that is, having the highest bankruptcy risk) are assigned 10 for BKRPTRANK.
evidence.description: Defines the direction of the Altman Z decile rank.

evidence.quote: Table 5 Logistic regression results explaining full disclosure of bad news in 8-K Item 4 filings
evidence.description: Confirms the reported baseline estimator.

evidence.quote: All p-values are one-tailed for coefficients having the expected signs and are two-tailed otherwise.
evidence.description: Shows reported inference is based on directional Wald chi-square p-values.
